threads.body: The pinned Together 2.32 API also accepts `video_url`, `audio_url`, and `input_audio` message parts, so this scenario does not satisfy the multimodal contract's “one call per non-text content kind the API takes” rule and the claim that this route has no audio is inaccurate. Add deterministic calls for the supported video/audio inputs (using suitable models), then regenerate `data.json`; if the service rejects any SDK-declared type, document that concrete limitation instead.
